title: What the Wood Keeps

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The stick keeps its notch and asks nothing. Ask it what the month's firings cost and it will give you the weather. The slate goes up the road and the count stays in the sleeve, and a man who can stand in a doorway is not a man who has been asked in.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Low Kiln bucket-round, in the month of Silt

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of four hundred and thirty-five to four hundred and thirty-seven days, six months and two hundred and fifty-five to two hundred and fifty-seven days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody; count 434 exact at the opening on answer 444, closing at 437 exact on answer 450. The old life rides the surgeon's register alone: no present-tense break is spent in this chapter and no \memory{} tag is used, the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field going on gathering interest from Chapter 113. No departure from the boy's eyes: the Debt Loft is a sound from above and behind, the back room a shape and a dust, the Drawing a room seen and not entered, the out-of-line landing a report brought up the yard and never a sighting. Silt 11, 12 and 13 are three ordinary tending days, each with its own dated \daymark and two full scenes of at least eight hundred words, with no market, no Cross, no bell, no Account-day, no called collector and no runner. Nothing from Silt 10's fourth reading crosses under the roof on any of the three days as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the reading is not made to answer the neighbour's near-reaching at the shelf. The house takes up its grammar as though nothing had turned. Sella keeps the whole hearth grammar at both ends of every day and the widow's mark stays untouched; seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule. On Silt 12 a second neighbour asks at the well whether a count kept in wood will be taken at the next reading, and Ilva's hand goes flat over the fold before her eyes to the asker and her mouth after both, and she answers the question put and not the one behind it; the asking is filed on its own place, advanced and not paid. On Silt 13 a man from Slate Row whose name is on no roll stands at the yard's edge with his hands loose and the patient face of a man who can wait in a doorway; nobody asks him what he wants and he does not say, no loaf passes, no slate is shown, no word carries and no threshold is crossed. The offered figure, the reported second slate of Silt 6, the hair-thin thaw of Silt 7, the neighbour's near-reaching, the five shaping, the clerk's entered figure and the two market sightings stay found where put with a finger between every pair.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Eleventh Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: First entry, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first dated \daymark{435}{Silt 11, Y.H. 814, Firstday}: the small hours open on the hand laid flat on the fold on answer 444 and the count exact at 434, six months and two hundred and fifty-four days told by nobody, the fire's fifth unpaid and Garl's name unspoken the same number, with no next hand in the room and four readings behind one unsigned figure up the clay road in Berr's locked box. Then first grey, the carrying-down of the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, and the morning work of an ordinary Firstday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects only (salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with its finer grey, the twice-mended pot, the unforged collector sentence). Ilva offstage with her count still in wood, Hessa's slate unread up the road, Berr up the clay road with the box locked and the key gone up in a coat pocket, the soft-cuffed clerk reported at the out-of-line landing and never a sighting. No market, Cross, bell, reading, runner or collector, and nothing from the fourth reading crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. Dramatic purpose: the surgeon takes the body in its old order — one stiff brown-edged barley crust gone past leather into old horn two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put in the empty place and still a finding and not a placing, the thread stiff in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the small bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back as at the end of a line written out for it, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a basket set level out of the draught where the heat comes sideways is the rewarming he would choose and could not ask for; the infant's three wants (crust lifted, thread wiped, a hand on the pot handle) quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither buying the other, and the quarrel is the work (T060/T086/T097). Sella's whole hearth grammar holds ahead of the basket — fire before basket, coals told it is the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, intake/hold/letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on the shelf's top so the charcoal stays unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand shut half over nothing, twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool unfigured, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched because a Firstday morning is not an opening and seven openings are seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100). Tarn keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence with no name on the man who turned back at the frozen ford and no figure on the tile debt, the small knife at the edge of its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, *Six counted. The next I don't count* found where put and not a habit, a tenth stopping, a payment or a rule, and the ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan with the term ended and the loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006); Jorra's meal-fine grey slate dust comes past the bent finger, dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, the wheel and a pot spoken to before any person, the full note withheld from any master who would call it early, his bent finger taking the cold out of the damper ahead of the unfinished sentence and coming out without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn against the burned slate at five (T035/T031/T062). The boy keeps 435 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-five days, and files answer 445 on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air and not a doctrine (T071/T072). Sensory anchors: tallow and woodsmoke, wet wool, the dry scrape of a pot's back on coals, barley wall to wall without a number, the pale clip-ring at Tarn's wrist, fine grey slate dust white in a fist-crease. Emotional turn: the house takes up its grammar as though nothing had turned, and the boy's two registers quarrel without a verdict; the wanting goes on. Last image: the boy's hand outside the wool takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and comes down flat on the fold on answer 445, with no next hand in the room.

scenes.title: What the Eleventh Left
scenes.synopsis: Second entry, no new dated heading: Silt 11 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 446 filed and the count at 435 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-five days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; Tarn and Jorra Vail offstage at kindling and wheel-shed with their keepings found where put; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons only at the yard grammar: a pail set down on the flat stone by the well with its flat knock, a rope settling into its knot with the cold-stiffened rasp, barley wall to wall without a number, a loaf pushed a finger's width along a board and stopped with nobody calling the stopping a figure. Ilva offstage with her strip in wood and her ninth hand nine; Hessa's single slate unread up the road, Berr's box locked up the road, the clerk still reported at the out-of-line landing and never a sighting, a witness or a tenth hand. Dramatic purpose: the boy takes the yard's small sounds first because they do not lie and the large ones are mostly weather, and takes each apart by fist, eye, mouth and the half-beat in the gap, giving the gap no intention, for an intention wants a payer where none stands (T061/T082). He goes once around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, once and not twice, widest at the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come back; the trough keeps the gone pan's round print on a place of its own, and the two unswept lines at the corner keep a finger between the clean dark line and its finer grey called the thaw, thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash and not looked at twice (T098, T009/T013/T092, T083/T085/T092 held). Costs come as directions and go away as weather and leave no entry: a fist arrives nowhere toward the light, a woman sent for a pot's cost gets a note and not a price, and the arithmetic read over covered grain at home does not know what it cost, the ink-neat space between figure and price unsigned (T077). Sella carries him down and up at the half-pace, goes to the fire before the basket at both ends of the day, tells the coals it is the thaw and does not tell the basket, keeps the charcoal unread beneath her finger, lifts the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing, turns the dressed grain under wool, sets the rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, touches the widow's mark at no shelf, well, rack, basket, yard or going of the light, and adds no second fold (T058/T079/T100). The six hearings of the full note stand beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing house's flat knock outside on its own place; the heard bell stands beside the told bell with both gaps in their squares and three counts in three places staying three; nine record-first hands stand with nine stoppings and no tenth; the offered figure and its return, the well-asking answered with the weather, the second man's turned slate and direction, the clerk's entered figure brought up the yard as a report, the fifth shaping, the three likenesses of Slate Row, the neighbour's near-reaching, the reported second slate of the sixth, the hair-thin thaw of the seventh, the burned slate at five and the four ownerless directions stay each on a place of its own with a finger between every pair, none stood up as a rule, a witness, a tenth hand, a sixth shaping, a doctrine or a payer (T080/T090/T102, T078/T061/T082, T097, T065/T095, T101 held). Silt 20 stands nine mornings off as a date and is not brought; the fourth reading is not made to answer anything under this roof. Sensory anchors: the flat knock of a pail on stone, cold-stiffened rope, the sour tang of Ash in the unswept corner, woodsmoke and tallow on the fold, the rough wash-towel at the head of the bed. Emotional turn: the yard's ordinary arithmetic stays unentered, and the boy's file stays exact and worth nothing; the day closes without a verdict and without a payer. Last image: the river keeps its low note of water over water under the winter skin, softer at one edge, and the hand comes up an inch toward it (the inch not a reach), takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the note's finishing, lets it go and comes straight down flat on the fold on answer 446, and there is no next hand in the room.

scenes.title: The Twelfth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: Third entry and second dated \daymark{436}{Silt 12, Y.H. 814, Secondday}: the small hours open on the hand laid down on answer 446 and the count exact at 435, six months and two hundred and fifty-five days told by nobody; then first grey, the carrying-down of the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, and the morning of an ordinary Secondday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard grammar; Ilva offstage with her strip still in her sleeve. No market, Cross, bell, Account-day, called collector or runner, and nothing from Silt 11 crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer. New day, new date, no recap. Dramatic purpose: the body is inventoried in the old order and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086/T097). The morning's honest work is given its exact texture — the dressed grain lifted for damp, turned piece by piece with a progressively lighter touch and laid back under wool with no figure or handful, the pot board and its twice-mended pot, the half-beat at the setting — and the surgeon reads the house by what it will not say rather than by what it will not survive. Sella's fire-before-basket grammar holds at the morning ahead of the basket in every order; the widow's mark is untouched because a Secondday morning is not an opening and seven openings in seven months are seven and not a rule (T058/T079). Tarn's six stand in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip, the hand goes over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, *Six counted. The next I don't count* is found where put and not made a habit, a tenth stopping, a payment or a rule; the ear-sentence stays stopped at the word that would call the loan, the Seed 16 breath unspent, his valuable ear exposure and not safety in an ended term with the fear of being entered again for vagrancy still his without a figure (T036/T076/T006). Jorra's bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, one bite holding and one taking with no Grathic word for both, and he comes out without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time; the full note stays withheld, *he's not Vail* sealed, the promise to the men who burn slates neither given nor withdrawn against the burned slate at five (T035/T031/T062). The boy keeps 436 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-six days, and files answer 447 on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air and not a doctrine (T071/T072). Sensory anchors: damp grain cool under the palm, tallow and low smoke, the cold bite of the damper iron, Ash grey in Tarn's knuckle creases, pale clip-ring catching what little light there is. Emotional turn: the ordinary work goes on unchanged while the yard's private keepings wait on their separate places; the boy checks each place and adds no figure. Last image: answer 447 is laid on the sixth place beside the others with a finger between every pair, and the seventh place stays empty.

scenes.title: What the Twelfth Left
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: Silt 12 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the day, with answer 448 filed and the count at 436 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-six days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan carried to the yard well, Sella Vail, Ilva at the well drawing with the pail against her knee; Tarn and Jorra Vail offstage at kindling and wheel-shed; Garl Vail in objects. Day already dated in Scene 3. Dramatic purpose: **the chapter's one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T080 with T090/T102).** In the afternoon a second neighbour at the yard well, having heard the round's talk of the figure that went back into the fist on Ilmen 26, asks whether a count kept in wood will be taken at the next reading — not a second offer, not the old question repeated, but the fear advanced by another mouth. Ilva's hand goes flat over the fold in her sleeve before her eyes go to the asker and her mouth after both, the half-beat lying in the gap where a lesser observer would put an intention; the short strip of notched birch stays in its fold, pale where a thumb has rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain between, and is not taken out, read, copied, counted, shown or joined. No figure comes off the wood, no slate is opened within reach of the basket, no room is entered and no reader is made. She answers the question put and not the one behind it — *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account* — and puts the flat of her hand once more on the sleeve, and goes back to the pail, nobody turning twice. The boy takes the order of reaching apart by the place of each part and files the **second asking** on a place of its own beside Ilva's offered figure and its return, her ninth record-first hand and the fifth shaping of the well-saying, with a finger between every pair: not a second offer, not a custom, not a tenth hand, not a witness, not a sale, not the calling of the loan, no figure under it and no payer, and expressly not joined to the clerk's entered figure, the reported second slate of Silt 6, the neighbour's near-reaching at the shelf, the well-asking answered with the weather or the three likenesses of Slate Row. Ilva's fear is advanced and left unpaid, and the hand that will one day lay the district's private keepings together is still far off and is not his. The asking is not repeated on Silt 13. At the going of the light Sella's whole grammar comes back as though nothing had turned: fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot's back, charcoal unread beneath her finger, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand shut half over nothing, twice-mended pot thumb-first with both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched, and no second fold added to the keeping found where put (T058/T079/T100, T060/T086/T097). Costs go away as weather and leave no entry (T077); the six hearings stay six with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside (T061/T082). Sensory anchors: pale clay dried in Ilva's nail crescents, finer rack dust in one thumb seam, the stiff rope's cold rasp, the flat knock of the pail on the stone lip, the sleeve's fold rubbed pale by a thumb. Emotional turn: the question is asked and answered in a breath and the fear is left standing where it was put; the boy files the nearness and refuses to make it a joining, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. Last image: the hand comes down flat on the fold on answer 448 with no next hand in the room, and the count holds at 436 exact while Ilva's stick keeps its notch nine days into Silt with no figure taken off it.

scenes.title: The Thirteenth Morning of Silt
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry and third dated \daymark{437}{Silt 13, Y.H. 814, Thirdday}: the small hours open on the hand laid down on answer 448 and the count exact at 436, six months and two hundred and fifty-six days told by nobody; then first grey, the carrying-down of the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, and the morning of an ordinary Thirdday. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail at the hearth before the basket, Tarn at the kindling and flagstones, Jorra Vail at the wheel-shed edge; Garl Vail in objects. Walk-ons at the yard grammar. No market, Cross, bell, Account-day, called collector or runner, and nothing from Silt 12's asking crosses under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; the second asking is not told again on a day that earned only its thirteenth. New day, new date, no recap. Dramatic purpose: the body is inventoried in the old order — crust gone into old horn with its hair-lifted corner two inches off, the keeping found where put in the empty place, the thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and wrist, the Afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody will perform — and the infant's three wants quarrel without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086/T097). The surgeon's register reads the body by the order of its small failures and buys nothing; the infant's want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle goes on without a verdict. Sella's grammar holds at both ends of the morning, fire before basket, the charcoal unread under her finger, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing, the grain covered and unfigured, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the widow's mark untouched (T058/T079/T100). Tarn's six and seventh stand where the house can check and cannot, the knife at the sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held, *Six counted. The next I don't count* found where put and not made a habit or a tenth stopping, the loan uncalled in a term already ended (T036/T076/T006). Jorra's dusty forearms are parted from clean as clot from vessel, three or more unnamed men go low into the back room before first grey and get no name from him, the bent finger leads at the damper, the full note is known three turns ahead and withheld from any master come up from High Kiln, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn against the burned slate at five (T035/T031/T062). The boy keeps 437 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-seven days, and files answer 449 on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air and not a doctrine (T071/T072). Sensory anchors: the dry kiln heat, the brown-edged horn of the crust, woodsmoke and wet wool, the clean dark line at the Vail corner thickened with Ash, the pale thumb-rub on Ilva's absent strip remembered as a shape and not a figure. Emotional turn: the morning is lived without event while the exposure planted in the yard waits where it was put; the boy adds no number to it. Last image: answer 449 is filed on the sixth place and the count reaches 437 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-seven days told by nobody, with the fire's fifth still unpaid and Garl's name still unspoken the same number.

scenes.title: What the Thirteenth Left
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Silt 13 afternoon through the going of the light and the small hours closing the chapter, with answer 450 filed and the count at 437 exact, six months and two hundred and fifty-seven days told by nobody. Present: Corin/Dan, Sella Vail; the man from Slate Row seen at the yard's edge and given no sheet, no name, no interior, no errand and no standing as a witness; Tarn and Jorra Vail offstage at kindling and wheel-shed; Garl Vail in objects; Ilva offstage with her count in wood and her fear unpaid. Dramatic purpose: **a further exposure planted, advanced and NOT paid (T090/T080 with T036/T076 and T035/T031).** In the afternoon a man from Slate Row whose name is on no roll stands at the yard's edge with his hands loose and the patient face of a man who can wait in a doorway; nobody asks him what he wants and he does not say; no loaf passes, no slate is shown, no word carries and no threshold is crossed. The boy takes the face apart by the place of each part — hands, face, the space a question would fill and does not — and files it on a place of its own beside the older record-first hands, the watcher's late turn and the first man's face at the edge, with a finger between it and Ilva's second asking of Silt 12 and another between it and the Slate Row likenesses; he does not lay it across the clerk's entered figure, the reported second slate, the neighbour's near-reaching or the fourth reading, does not make a tenth hand, a reader, a witness, a sale, a payment or a payer of it, and does not bring it under the roof as a lesson. The household's exposure goes on gathering toward the far-off calling and is not called here: Tarn's valuable ear in an ended term with the loan uncalled, Jorra's promise ungiven against the burned slate at five, Berr's kindness and *your house* believed and not owed, the Kindling collector's reason, the clean voice's missing name and the Long Night story's empty name on their own trays (T090/T080, T036/T076, T035/T031, T065/T095). Sella carries him home at the going of the light at the half-pace from every open slate and says nothing to the basket of the face at the edge or of what the day was; under the roof the whole grammar comes back as though nothing had turned, and she righted the fold without a look at his face or a second fold, the keeping found where put and still a finding (T058/T079, T060/T086/T097). In the small hours the towel comes out at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done, and the boy goes over the day by the place of each thing with every gap left a gap and does not add them; the six hearings stand beside with the seventh empty and the Drawing's knock outside, the heard bell beside the told with both gaps in their squares and three counts in three places staying three, nine record-first hands with nine stoppings and no tenth, seven openings in seven months and not a rule. Four readings of the year stand behind one unsigned figure, four being four and not one account, the first not a thirteenth, the second no signature, the third no doctrine, the fourth no payer, the twelve of Y.H. 813 not laid across the four, the figure read still not the figure paid, and the fourth reading not made to answer any kept thing under this roof (T015/T041/T047, T078/T061/T082). Answer 450 is filed on the sixth place, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment; six honest answers 445 through 450 stand there, two to each of the three days, and not one is a doctrine. The unsent call to Nina stays where it was put and is not paid again (T020). Sensory anchors: road-mud drying on a pair of boots at the yard's edge, the patient set of loose hands, tallow and low smoke under the roof, the rough wash-towel smelling of woodsmoke, the river's low note under its winter skin. Emotional turn: the watcher is seen and not entered, the nearness is filed and not joined, and the house closes over the day without a verdict; the wanting goes on. Last image: through the finger's-width door the river keeps water over water under its winter skin, the hand outside the wool comes up an inch toward it (the inch not a reach), takes a small intake, holds the interval whole on the note's finishing, lets it go and comes straight down flat on the fold on answer 450; there is no next hand in the room, the four low pulls under the boards keep their silence where the fifth should have stood with nobody supplying it, and the chapter goes forward into a fourteenth day not lived and not brought.
